description: This file contains the ViewModel class 'NoteEditorViewModel' for managing note editing operations in a SwiftUI iOS app, including saving and deleting notes with synchronization.

classes.name: NoteEditorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class responsible for handling note editing state and operations such as save and delete, conforming to ObservableObject for SwiftUI binding.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view model with a note, repository, and sync engine, setting up initial state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the updated note to the repository and triggers a synchronization.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the note from the repository and triggers a synchronization.
